D: A lonely German boy discovers his mother is hiding a Jewish girl in their attic.
P: Serve the mains when Rosie sets the table and pretends to be Jojo's dad.
S: Crisp grated potato and onion pancakes with apple sauce
Grated potato and onion squeezed dry, mixed with egg and flour, fried in small pancakes until crisp, apple sauce and sour cream.
Dark rye with salted butter, sliced radishes and chives

Dark rye bread sliced thin, spread with salted butter and topped with sliced radishes, chives and flaky salt. Slice 1 dark rye loaf thin. Spread each slice with salted butter, about 100g in total, right to the crust. Top with 1 bunch thinly sliced radishes, snipped chives and a pinch of flaky salt, then cut into fingers.
Soft pretzels with Obatzda cheese dip
the little German town where Jojo and Rosie live

Warm salted soft pretzels with Obatzda, a Bavarian dip of camembert, butter, cream cheese, paprika and onion, with pickled cucumbers on the side. Make a dough with 500g plain flour, 7g yeast, 1 tsp salt and 320ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and rest 1 hour. Heat the oven to 220C. Shape 8 pretzels, dip each in 2L simmering water with 70g bicarb for 30 seconds, brush with egg, add rock salt and bake 14 minutes. Mash 200g ripe camembert with 50g soft butter, 100g cream cheese, 2 tsp sweet paprika, half a finely diced onion and caraway. Serve with sliced dill cucumbers.
M: Smoked sausage, potato and cabbage simmered with caraway
Smoked sausages simmered with cabbage, potatoes, onion, caraway and stock until thick, crusty bread on the side.
a proper German dinner for a better day

Chicken breast pounded thin, crumbed and fried golden in butter, with a warm Swabian potato salad, cucumber dill salad and lemon wedges. Boil 1kg waxy potatoes 20 minutes, slice warm and toss with 150ml hot chicken stock, 3 tbsp white wine vinegar, 1 tbsp mustard, 1 diced eschalot and chives. Slice 1 cucumber thin and toss with dill, sour cream and salt. Halve 2 large chicken breasts horizontally and pound to 5mm. Coat in flour, 2 beaten eggs and 150g breadcrumbs. Fry in 50g butter and 3 tbsp oil for 3 minutes a side until golden. Serve with lemon.
W: Soft yeast tray cake topped with baked plums and cinnamon sugar

A soft yeasted dough pressed into a tray, covered in halved plums, sprinkled with cinnamon sugar and baked at 190C. Mix 300g flour, 7g dried yeast, 50g sugar, 150ml warm milk, 1 egg and 50g soft butter into a dough and prove 1 hour. Press into a lined tray, cover with 1kg halved plums cut side up, sprinkle with 50g sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon, and bake at 190C for 35 minutes.
K: Elsa in the walls spiced apple punch
Warm apple juice with cinnamon, cloves, star anise and orange

Cloudy apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves, star anise and orange peel, sweetened with honey and served steaming in mugs with an apple slice. Pour 1.2L cloudy apple juice into a saucepan. Add 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, 2 star anise, 3 strips of orange peel and 2 tbsp honey. Bring just to a simmer, then turn the heat to low and steep for 15 minutes without boiling. Strain into 4 mugs and float a thin apple slice and a cinnamon stick in each. In summer, chill it and top with sparkling water over ice instead.

steps.text: Grate the potatoes and onion and squeeze out as much liquid as you can.
Mix with the eggs, flour and salt.
Fry heaped spoonfuls in oil until crisp on both sides, in batches.
Serve hot with apple sauce and sour cream.
Spread each slice with butter right to the crust.
Top with thinly sliced radishes, snipped chives and flaky salt, then cut into fingers.
Slice the onion and sausages and dice the potatoes. Shred the cabbage.
Fry the onion in a big pot, add the sausages and brown.
Add the potatoes, cabbage, caraway and stock. Simmer until the potatoes are soft and the stew is thick.
Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, milk, egg and butter into a dough.
Prove the dough, which is the resting time.
Press into a lined tray and cover with halved plums, cut side up.
Sprinkle with the sugar and cinnamon and bake at 190C.

s.note: Crisp grated potato and onion pancakes with apple sauce
s.how: Grate 800g potatoes and 1 onion, squeeze out as much liquid as you can, then mix with 2 eggs, 3 tbsp flour and 1 tsp salt. Fry heaped spoonfuls in oil for 3 minutes a side until crisp. Serve hot with 200g apple sauce and 150g sour cream.

m.note: Smoked sausage, potato and cabbage simmered with caraway
m.how: Fry 1 sliced onion in a big pot, add 500g sliced smoked sausages and brown. Add 600g diced potatoes, half a cabbage shredded, 1 tsp caraway seeds and 750ml stock. Simmer 30 minutes until the potatoes are soft and the stew is thick, then serve with crusty bread.
